title: How to Install
subtitle: Get started in less than 2 minutes.

steps.title: Download APK
steps.description: Click the download button to get the latest InstaMax Premium APK file.

steps.title: Enable Unknown Sources
steps.description: Go to Settings > Security and enable installation from unknown sources.

steps.title: Install & Enjoy
steps.description: Open the downloaded file, install it, and log in to your account.
